headline: The Wall Street Journal reports that the AI industry is counting on the United States spending about 9% of its yearly economic output on AI.
score_reason: Lowered from 8: headline only, so the size, timeframe and basis of the 9% figure could not be checked.
importance_line: If the industry's hopes are met, AI spending would become a large share of the US economy, which could matter to workers, savers and companies alike, but it is not known over what period or on what basis the 9% figure is calculated.
summary: The Wall Street Journal asks whether the United States will spend about 9% of its GDP, the total value of everything the country produces in a year, on AI, and says the AI industry is counting on it.
notes: WSJ paywall (HTTP 401); no other outlet found with the same story. Headline only.
